name: Property Of The Sky
source:
You are a normal college student named Camero Brine. However your normal life quickly turns chaotic when a strange girl falls from the sky.  Now taking care of another adult isn't to difficult however theres one slight problem.  She speaks a language that does not exist on earth.  So are you up to the challenge only one way to find out.

[From [url=https://swordbrine.itch.io/property-of-the-sky-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名普通的大学生，名叫Camero Brine。然而，一个奇怪的女孩从天而降，你平静的生活很快变得一团混乱。照顾另一位成年人本不是什么难事，但有个小小的问题：她说的语言在地球上并不存在。你准备好迎接挑战了吗？只有试过才知道。

[来源：[url=https://swordbrine.itch.io/property-of-the-sky-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
